Link up, lock in, make something cute 🧿✨ Azúcar's Main Floor is turning into a craft table and YOU'RE invited to build your own carabiner or charm bracelet from scratch. Jayme's hosting this one and trust — it's giving Friendsgiving energy before Friendsgiving even happens. Grab your beads, grab a stranger-turned-friend, and get crafting. Bring a snack to share because we're building community one charm at a time. This is a PFLAG co-presented night, so you already know the vibes are soft and the welcome is real. Mark it, don't miss it. 💛

Picture this: twinkly charms clinking, snacks passed around the table, laughter mixing with the sound of beads hitting the floor (it happens, no judgment) 🫶 That's Link Up. Azúcar's Main Floor goes full craft-corner for one night — carabiners, charm bracelets, keychains, and the kind of easy conversation that happens when your hands are busy and your guard is down. Jayme's hosting, the room is warm, and every piece you make walks out the door with you. It's slow, it's sweet, it's exactly what a Sunday night in November should feel like. 🍂✨

Come as you are, leave with a bracelet AND new friends 🧡 Link Up isn't about being the best crafter in the room — it's about showing up, sharing a snack, and making something with your hands next to people who get it. Jayme's hosting this PFLAG co-presented night on Azúcar's Main Floor, and whether you're a regular or walking in solo for the first time, there's a seat at the table for you. All supplies included, no experience needed, just good company and good charms. This is what community looks like. 💛

Everything you need to know about Link Up 📋 It's a Friendsgiving craft night at Azúcar, hosted by Jayme and co-presented with PFLAG. Build your own carabiner or charm bracelet — all crafting supplies are included with your ticket. Bring a non-perishable snack or treat to share with the table. Doors open at 6PM, it's an 18+ event, and tickets are just $10. Simple, sweet, and worth the night out.
